timing_scope: sum of timed analyzer regions; excludes initial NumPy import and final artifact serialization; entire processes each limited to45 CPU seconds
novelty_scope: H6 terminal objective alignment repeats prior same-bank diagnostics; new contribution is H1..H6 plus pairwise margins/ties and regret accounting, not a new independent discovery

literature.relevance: Plan-Real and CEM-stage rank diagnostics are prior art. Ours reuses fixed multiscale banks, not stagewise CEM samples; requested coverage and XY are distinct from their full7D L2 proxy.
Cost-gap bounds protect model-cost choices, not environment utility. Our actual-encoding comparison needs known futures and is not online ACPC.
MountainCar behavior probabilities are encoder-centroid distance softmax, not an independent control objective; response geometry does not establish robot-goal metric validity.

protocol.independent_units: four previously seen DEVELOPMENT states; not 256 independent samples
protocol.objective: mean visual squared error + 0.1 * mean proprio squared error to exact frozen goal
protocol.coverage_goal: FROZEN_INPUTS goal_state[2:5], not native painted default goal
protocol.tie_policy: exact cost ties; physical ties abs<=1e-12; smallest index plus tied outcome ranges
protocol.reliability: descriptive pairwise ordering agreement, not calibrated probability; pairs dependent
protocol.float_policy: record CPU vs cached GPU discrepancy as measurement floor, not bit identity
protocol.physical_oracles: nondeployable within-bank upper bounds, not policies or independent confirmations
protocol.actual_encoding_oracle: unavailable online; perfect-forecast cost selection, NOT physical utility upper bound
